headline: Alpa Laboratories Limited files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Alpa Laboratories Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or triggering a takeover obligation. The specific identity of the acquirer, consideration, and transaction structure remain undisclosed in public search results; the NSE filing constitutes the formal regulatory notice.
detail: The disclosure was filed with the NSE (CCDATA portal) on 8 June 2026 per the timestamp on the archived PDF. Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, any person acquiring 25% or more of a target's equity (or voting rights) must make a public announcement and file detailed disclosures. Regulation 31(4) requires the acquirer to furnish the disclosure to the target and exchanges within the statutory timeline. The pharmaceutical company Alpa Laboratories is the subject of this transaction.
